visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with auburn hair and a white t-shirt featuring a crown logo is seated in a Japanese ramen restaurant. She looks at a bowl of ramen with bright green broth with a shocked expression. (2) The scene cuts to the restaurant exterior showing a white curtain with 'ICHZAN' text and a three-leaf logo. It then shifts to a close-up of a vending machine screen where a finger points to a menu item showing green ramen priced at 1200 yen. (3) An overhead close-up shows the ramen bowl containing a vibrant green soup, two halves of a soft-boiled egg, chicken slices, red onions, and a large green leaf. (4) The woman uses a black spoon to taste the green soup, followed by exaggerated facial expressions showing confusion. (5) She proceeds to eat the noodles using chopsticks while speaking directly to the camera. Digital sweat-drop and light-bulb graphics appear around her head. (6) A young man with dark hair and a striped polo shirt is shown trying the same green ramen, looking thoughtful as he tastes the broth. (7) Another young person wearing glasses and a NASA t-shirt tastes the ramen and reacts positively with a smile and a thumbs up while holding a small microphone.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 main creators (1 female, 2 male) and approximately 5 background patrons in the restaurant.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The primary woman has long auburn hair with bangs, wearing a white t-shirt. The first male guest has short dark hair and a black-and-white striped polo. The second guest has short hair, glasses, and a white NASA t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A warm, wood-paneled Japanese ramen shop with traditional banners, a vending machine, and other customers seated at tables.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, enthusiastic female voice describes a green ramen dish over an upbeat, bright acoustic guitar pop track. (2) A mechanical 'click' sound effect coincides with a visual cut to a vending machine. (3) Loud slurping sounds are heard, mixed with short 'pop' and 'boing' cartoon sound effects that punctuate the host's reactions. (4) Background restaurant chatter and the clinking of ceramic bowls are audible beneath the voices. (5) A male voice with a lower, calmer pitch shares a tasting reaction, followed by another male voice with an energetic, positive tone. (6) The BGM remains a consistent, driving major-key rhythm throughout the duration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Intro -> Ordering Process -> Taste Test -> Multi-person Opinion Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review a highly unique and visually striking culinary item (Matcha Chicken Paitan Ramen) in Osaka, exploring whether the unconventional combination of tea and savory broth works through real-time reactions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While the restaurant ICHZAN is clearly identified, the tone is that of an independent vlog exploring a viral food trend rather than a paid advertisement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing styles (Variety-show subtitles and sound effects) to emphasize the 'conflict' in flavors of the unique dish.
